goal.request: Persist three researched body-aesthetic keyword pixel test cases, then test each in an independently randomized complex reference-informed render.

evidence.claim: The fixture binds one global, one regional, and one local semantic profile to exact hard gates, false substitutes, thumbnail/native scales, and an all-gates-in-one-image verdict.
The JSONL parsed and the related 50-test suite passed; a final focused 8-test rerun also passed.
The contrapposto v6 pack activated the exact hard profile and both composed and runtime audits passed.
The arm-waist negative-space v6 pack activated the exact hard profile and both composed and corrected runtime audits passed.
The philtral-contour v6 pack activated the exact hard profile and the composed and runtime audits passed.
Three of four contrapposto gates passed, but the thumbnail counter-tilt remained ambiguous after the one allowed repair.
Only the void-shape gate passed; the final wedge was garment-created and crossed by a cord, so three of four gates failed after the one allowed repair.
All four philtral surface-topography gates passed in the first saved image at the required scales.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: For each selected keyword, every registry-bound hard gate must coexist in one saved independently generated image at its required review scales.

invariants.statement: Prompt wording, audit success, or components split across attempts cannot substitute for all hard gates in one saved image.
Each arm freezes a randomized standalone authorial core before reading the local profile and candidate pack data.
The supplied portrait guides facial appearance only and cannot establish identity, ethnicity, health, or body value.

mismatches.source_state: A thumbnail-readable counter-tilt completes the support-leg and free-leg load path.
mismatches.render_state: The vest, hair, clipboard, and coverall conceal or flatten the pelvic and shoulder slopes, leaving a generic crossed-leg weight shift.

mismatches.source_state: An uninterrupted background patch is bounded by the real raised arm and waist contours.
mismatches.render_state: A coat flap and plumb line create or cross the triangular wedge, which reads as a garment cutout rather than a body-bounded opening.

hypotheses.statement: Operational wardrobe and the handheld checklist compete with the low-contrast pelvis and shoulder landmarks, so the requested counter-tilt loses thumbnail salience despite literal prompt coverage.
hypotheses.falsifier: A held-out full-body scene with the same profile, unobscured hip and shoulder lines, and no handheld torso occluder still fails the counter-tilt gate.

hypotheses.statement: The generator satisfies a requested triangular void by inventing a high-contrast garment opening before it preserves anatomical boundary ownership.
hypotheses.falsifier: A held-out arm-waist case with a continuous solid garment surface and no cord or side flap produces an actual two-contour background opening.

hypotheses.statement: A face-dominant close portrait allocates enough pixels and form light for the philtral ridges, groove, and paired lip arc to survive both native and 256-pixel review.
hypotheses.falsifier: A held-out close portrait with comparable face scale and form light fails one or more philtral gates.

intervention.general_rule: Persist exact profile-bound pixel cases that fail closed on substitutes and require every hard gate in one saved image at thumbnail and native scales.
intervention.generalization_basis: The three cases span global pose, regional composition, and local surface anatomy rather than repeating one body feature or one photographic concept.

decision.rationale: The test contract and prompt routing are implemented and validated, but only one of three independent renders passed every pixel gate; the keyword set is not sufficiently render-validated.
